query: Who is covered by this memorandum?
response:
I can’t reliably answer who is covered without knowing which specific memorandum you’re referring to.

“Memorandum” could mean, for example (among many possibilities):

- The 2023 U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) draft memorandum on federal use of AI  
- A White House or Executive Office memorandum implementing the 2023 AI Executive Order  
- A Department of Defense memorandum on responsible AI or autonomous weapons  
- An internal corporate AI governance memo  
- An EU Commission staff working document or guidance memo  
- A university or research-institute AI safety policy memo  

Each of these has a *different* scope—some cover only U.S. federal executive agencies, some apply to all federal contractors, some to specific departments (e.g., DoD, DHS), and some to a single organization or project team.

To give a specific, factual answer, I’d need at least one of the following:

- The title or date of the memorandum  
- The issuing body (e.g., “OMB M-24-10”, “DoD memorandum on Autonomous Weapons, Jan 2024”)  
- Or the full text or a screenshot of the memo (especially the “Scope,” “Applicability,” or “Covered Entities” section)

If you provide that, I can identify exactly who is covered and summarize it clearly.
ground_truth: All Executive Branch departments and agencies, including independent regulatory agencies.
